methodology: A fresh, adversarial re-read of the full document-classifier.ts/types.ts diff (git diff e1f47a4 HEAD, the pre-classifier-fix commit vs. current HEAD) against the mission's Section 9 checklist, performed as a separate pass from the implementation work itself.

checklist.firstMatchKeywordDependence: FIXED. Tier 2 no longer returns the type of the first RULE checked in array order; it returns the type whose earliest TEXT-POSITION match across all rules is numerically smallest. Confirmed via direct code reading and via the real Riot doc-a re-trace (01-root-cause.json): COMPLIANCE_CERTIFICATE's array-index-7 priority no longer beats CREDIT_AGREEMENT's array-index-12 position when CREDIT_AGREEMENT's own text position (276) is earlier than COMPLIANCE_CERTIFICATE's (2604).
checklist.benchmarkSpecificStrings: NONE FOUND. Grepped the full diff for Riot/Coinbase/'Platforms, Inc' - zero matches (confirmed both by this independent grep and by the automated grep test in pre-unseen-classifier-remediation.test.ts).
checklist.titleZoneAssumptionsThatFailOnCommonSecF: Validated against the real Riot SEC EX-10.1 filing text (confidentiality-redaction banner + bold caption + party block + Table of Contents + Exhibit list, all within the 3000-char PREAMBLE_WINDOW) and against 10 synthetic C1-C10 adversarial fixtures covering TOC/exhibit contamination, attached forms, standalone ancillary documents, omnibus multi-target amendments, and fused dual-type captions. No fixed-character title-zone window was introduced (the mission's own explicitly-rejected approach, per 02-classifier-design.json) - the mechanism is purely position-comparison based, with no dependency on a specific document's overall length before its own caption.
checklist.tocContamination: FIXED for the demonstrated real case and the synthetic C1/C9/C10 generalizations - a later table-of-contents entry never beats an earlier real caption.
checklist.exhibitContamination: FIXED for the demonstrated case (C2: a full Compliance Certificate FORM attached as an exhibit) and C10 (7 distinct exhibit/form names in one document) - the base agreement's own earlier caption always wins.
checklist.amendmentsMisclassifiedAsBaseAgreements: FIXED and regression-tested: C4's two variants (a simple 'FIRST AMENDMENT TO CREDIT AGREEMENT...' caption and the real-shape 'FOURTH AMENDMENT...to the Credit Agreement...and to the Security Agreement...' omnibus caption) both correctly classify AMENDMENT, not the referenced base type. One pre-existing test that explicitly asserted the OLD, buggy SECURITY_AGREEMENT misclassification as a 'disclosed boundary' was updated to assert the new, correct AMENDMENT/AMENDS outcome, with its own reasoning re-verified in this audit pass (the fixture is unchanged; only the expected outcome and its rationale were updated).
checklist.embeddedFormsBecomingParentDocumentIdent: FIXED - C1/C2/C10 all confirm a base agreement's own identity remains stable regardless of how many or what kind of embedded exhibit/form names it contains.
checklist.falseConfidenceUnderAmbiguousEvidence: ADDRESSED via a new, narrowly-scoped ambiguity guard (DETERMINISTIC_CAPTION_AMBIGUOUS) - verified via C8's two sub-tests: a genuinely fused dual-type caption ('CREDIT AGREEMENT AND SECURITY AGREEMENT...') returns safe uncertainty (UNKNOWN/0 confidence), while a normal base document's own preamble mentioning another type far from its caption is confirmed to NEVER falsely trigger ambiguity (regression guard). The guard is deliberately scoped to fire only when the winning match is itself a base facility type (CREDIT_AGREEMENT/INDENTURE) - independently re-verified in this audit as the correct, minimal scope: every other RULES type inherently references a base facility or related document within its own caption by real, ordinary financing-document drafting convention (amendments name what they amend, guarantees name what they guarantee, joinders name what they join, intercreditor agreements name the facilities they govern) - an unscoped guard was proven, by this session's own design-iteration log (03-implementation-results.json), to false-positive on 19 legitimate pre-existing test cases before being narrowed to this scope.

mergeArithmeticSanityCheck: The diff does NOT merely rearrange RULES array order (which the mission explicitly says would FAIL this audit) - the RULES array, its patterns, and their relative order are byte-for-byte unchanged from before this session. The change is entirely in HOW the array is searched (position-based selection via earliestRuleMatch, replacing array-order-based selection via the old for-loop), never WHAT it searches for or in what order patterns are declared.
additionalObservations: Confirmed the fix's real-world effect closes the operative-document cycle identified in the prior remediation session's own replay (docs/post-3f2-remediation/08b-riot-package-graph-replay.json) - independently re-verified via a full re-execution of the deterministic package-graph/amendment pipeline against the real, frozen Riot evidence (07-riot-deterministic-replay.json), not merely inferred from the classification change alone.

Confirmed via a temporary pre-fix worktree comparison that the deleted-carve-out node-supersession exposure (08-deleted-carveout-check.json) is unchanged before and after this fix - the fix neither improves nor worsens this specific, disclosed, pre-existing limitation.
verdict: NO BLOCKER FOUND. All Section 9 checklist items pass; the fix is structural (position-based selection), not a keyword-order rearrangement; zero benchmark-specific content; the one design iteration required to correctly scope the ambiguity guard is transparently documented, not hidden.
